name: Habitat Visual Navigation Challenge
description: A robotic vision-and-control benchmark for evaluating embodied agents in Habitat simulation on point-to-point navigation tasks using first-person visual observations. Agents must navigate to target locations efficiently and reliably in indoor environments.
evaluation_method: success_rate, SPL (success weighted by path length), navigation efficiency
notes: Commonly used to assess embodied AI and robot navigation policies in photo-realistic simulation. Exact benchmark variants and leaderboard scores can vary by task split and environment setup.
